name: uc5-japan-temps
_doc: UC5 — pixel-Japan tile-grid map with an instantaneous-temperature column per prefecture. Data: /api/v1/geo/japan-temps (Phase 1 simulated; Phase 2 live JMA AMeDAS behind the same URL). Design: docs/uc5-uc6-geo-dataspaces.md
